statement: For the locked n=16 round7 natural-switch assignment omitting bu,bw,uw, the 93-trace bad-C7 deletion hypergraph has singleton kernel F=R×(P∪U∪W) ∪ P×Q ∪ U×W ∪ K2(W), with disjoint block sizes 12,4,4,1. Its 72 triple traces meet F in two edges (12 traces) or three edges (60 traces), in exactly five block-signature classes of multiplicities 8,4,4,32,24. Hence every transversal contains F, F hits every trace, and tau=21.
closes: exact structural classification of the unique unprotected locked assignment
three-deletion repair no-go for that finite assignment
dependency_gaps: No reduction forces this five-block pattern in arbitrary hard graphs.
The result is finite and does not improve the public 1/8 exponent.
Other natural-switch budgets and non-natural constructions remain open.
